name: noacg-mcp
description: The NoaCG CLI as an always-on MCP server for Codex: one tool, noacg, with the CLI's verbs (types, scaffold, validate with screenshots, inspect, screenshot, docs, save). Optional - the noacg plugin's skill drives the same CLI from the terminal with no server.

interface.shortDescription: The NoaCG CLI as an MCP tool, always on
interface.longDescription: One MCP tool, noacg, speaking the NoaCG CLI's verbs with a browser kept warm between calls. Optional: the noacg plugin's skill drives the same CLI from the terminal with no server running; install this one when you want the tool present in every session.
